outcome: Self-perceived pain and perceived exertion during labor
finding: Regular antenatal exercises, including yoga, were associated with better outcomes related to labor, delivery, and pregnancy, including lower rates of cesarean section, lower weight gain, higher newborn weight, and reduced pain.
mod_finding: Women who engaged in regular antenatal exercises, including yoga, had significantly lower rates of cesarean section compared to those who did not.
birth_weight: Women who engaged in regular antenatal exercise had infants with higher birth weights
